name: Bonus for Woo
author: calliko

sections.description:
This plugin is designed to create a bonus system with cashback.
The cashback percentage is calculated based on the users’ status in the form of bonus points.
Each user status has a corresponding cashback percentage.
The users’ status depends on the total amount of the users orders.
Cashback is accumulated in the client’s virtual wallet.

Free plugin features

  • Points for product reviews.
  • Integer and decimal points
  • Hide the ability to spend points for discounted items.
  • Show the history of bonus points.
  • Email notifications.
  • Export and import points.
  • Shortcodes.

Additional settings for the PRO version

  • Points on your birthday.
  • Daily points for the first login.
  • Points for registration.
  • Exclude categories of products that cannot be purchased with cashback points.
  • Cashback is not accrued for discounted items.
  • Exclude payment methods.
  • Exclude items that cannot be purchased with Cashback Points.
  • Minimum order amount to redeem points.
  • Withdrawal of bonus points for inactivity.
  • Referral system.
  • Coupons.

Testing

You can test the plugin on this page

SUPPORT

If you need support or have questions, please write to our support or blog.
sections.installation:
1. Upload dir bonus-for-woo-computy to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
When are points awarded?

When the administrator marks the order as “Completed”

Why are points not awarded immediately after the order is paid?

This is done on purpose to exclude the case when the client has spent the earned
points, but decided to return the last product. In this case, the bonus balance goes negative.

When are points deducted?

When the customer confirms the order in checkout.

Possible cashback is not displayed in the shopping cart and checkout.

You are most likely logged in with an administrator account. Administrators are not involved
in the loyalty system.

Does the WooCommerce plugin support High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes, the plugin supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

  • Added user ID and email to the full history of points accrual.

6.6.8 – 2025-02-16

  • Fixed the error of the wrong amount when returning bonus points with other coupons.
  • Fixed the error of recalculating the amount of possible bonuses when writing off points.
  • Fixed the error Warning: in_array() expects parameter 2 to be array.

6.6.7 – 2025-01-22

  • Fixed saving of shortcode for writing off points.
  • Optimization of statistics page.

6.6.6 – 2025-01-14

  • Corrected translations.
  • Corrected styles when writing off points.
  • Fixed the error of correct calculation of the number of points written off.
  • Fixed the setting “minimum order amount for using points”.
  • Fixed export of bonus points.

6.6.5 – 2024-12-26

  • fixed fatal error on single page.

6.6.4 – 2024-12-25

  • Fixed exclusion of categories and products that cannot be purchased with bonuses.

6.6.3 – 2024-12-18

  • Added an alternative server for activating the Pro version.
  • Added a smooth closing of the points write-off form.
  • Added loading animation to the points write-off button.
  • Fixed the cookie entry for the referral system.
  • Fixed the deletion of the date of birth in the admin panel.

6.6.2 – 2024-12-15

  • Added a setting in the Pro version “When using a coupon, cashback is not accrued.”
  • Added the ability for the administrator to participate in the bonus system by default.
  • Added the ability to insert the write-off of points anywhere in the basket and checkout.
  • Added the filter bfw_add_points_order_status_filter.
  • Fixed the shortcode [bfw_get_sum_orders]
  • Fixed the error “Passing null to parameter #1 ($haystack) of type string is deprecated”
  • Fixed the error calculating points when using an offline product.

6.6.1 – 2024-12-08

  • Removed the write-off form for unregistered users.
  • Returned the cashback withdrawal in the basket for unregistered users.
  • If the administrator writes off points from the user during the checkout process where bonuses are applied, they will not be accepted.
  • Added filter bfw_not_use_points_text. Description in the manual.

6.6.0 – 2024-12-06

  • Added generation of a QR code for a referral link.
  • Changed the appearance of bonus points write-off.
  • Improved protection against fraud when writing off points.
  • Removed the system of writing off points at the expense of commissions.
  • Fixed the display of the history of accrual of points in the user account.
  • Fixed a fatal error in the product card.
  • Fixed an error in excluding a payment method in woocommerce blocks.
  • Fixed an error in accrual of points to the referrer for the first order.
  • Fixed translations.

6.5.4 – 2024-11-25

  • Minor bugs fixed.

6.5.3 – 2024-11-21

  • Fixed incorrect calculation of total order amount.

6.5.2 – 2024-10-31

  • Added support for woocommerce blocks on the cart and checkout page.
  • Fixed partial refunds exclusion from order totals.
  • Fixed compatibility with the Post SMTP plugin.

6.5.1 – 2024-11-14

  • Fixed an error with product registration for unauthorized users.
  • Fixed an entry in the history of points for non-existent users.

6.5.0 – 2024-10-28

  • Added shortcode [bfw_get_sum_orders] – output of the user’s order amount.
  • Added a setting that excludes delivery when calculating the order amount.
  • Fixed erroneous cashback accrual for a product that was purchased at a discount.
